conditions: 6 AM- Get outta bed and get psyched for an unforgettable Saturday of celebration under mostly sapphire skies. The Rendezvous Music Festival has returned! To miss out on this party would be more than regrettable, because the thin, hazy-high clouds will further airbrush the crystal visuals dancing in your eyes. We'll shred through seasonally unusual highs that zoom to the mid-40s at the summit and the mid-60s in Teton Village. Gentle morning winds will pick up this afternoon as they shift out of the west between 10 and 30 mph. You may wanna go bell-to-bell because the slush skiing rips, but save some energy in those curving hips so you can boogie 'til the sun goes down to the sound of the Flaming Lips. -Lege
